scope: Reviewed unchanged POSIX and ancestor-commit recipes with separate original-first orchestration and strict original/native runtime selection. Configured coverage is not executed coverage.

Replace raw CTest invocation with configuration-specific unit/Qt/kernel/auxiliary verification
Replace original-only functional invocation with both-transport original/native strict dispatch

BUILD_FUZZ_BINARY=OFF and BUILD_FOR_FUZZING=OFF on both sides; fuzz jobs retain the original driver
Keep native output paths for existing artifact consumers; original build/install artifacts use the bitcoin-baseline suffix
execution_status: unverified for actual inherited POSIX/hosted recipes
evidence_retention: Copy newly created bounded framework report trees into artifacts/pocx-inherited on success and failure; export container reports before cleanup; upload in inherited POSIX jobs
revision_runtime_prerequisites: Hosted job provisions BCC, matching kernel headers and pinned pycapnp; original USDT cases require root; published report permissions allow ordinary artifact upload. Actual hosted execution unverified.
native_feature_skip_review: Require the owned runner raw exit to agree exactly with terminal case statuses:0only for allpassed,1for any nonpass. Explicit source-guarded disabled features remain configuration-disabled even though the strict runner returns1. Case-level failures and skips for enabled or missing prerequisites still fail; inconsistent or abnormal exits fail. Controller fixtures verify both transports and preserve every skip row without relabeling it passed. No original test or feature inventory changed; actual inherited runtime remains unverified.
configuration_dispatch_review: Shared strict dispatch selects explicit multi-configuration binaries and CTest configuration; inherited functional timeout-factor flags are validated and preserved. Auxiliary registration identity uses resolved executable paths. Native Windows runtime remains unverified.
windows_functional_dispatch_review: Keep the unchanged upstream runner for all original variants; separately execute the ancient-release UTXO case in an ASCII-only directory in both transports on Windows. Wallet multiwallet variants remain required. Disabled benchmark builds preserve the source-guarded unexpanded case; enabled builds require actual listing. Pin bytecode and previous-release environment behavior; retain elapsed time and full raw logs. Callback verification is infrastructure only, not hosted or Windows execution.
windows_cross_export_review: Both reviewed CRT profiles build OFF then ON with unchanged compiler/features, export their immutable pair inside the container before cleanup, and publish one stable payload plus bounded reports. Cross-build success explicitly does not establish a target-host test baseline. Export/source/publication failures fail CI. Fuzz routing and native/POSIX execution remain unchanged. Actual hosted compilation and Windows execution unverified.

restored_upstream_profiles.coverage: Preserve original and native RPC coverage gates per transport with unchanged upstream evaluator; run the historical slow dbcrash exclusion as a documented selection extension. No execution claim.

runtime_stack_review: Preserve the inherited512KiB soft stack limit for every test process. Apply it as a soft limit only so reviewed Qt/kernel build subprocesses can restore their normal8MiB stack without changing caller/test limits. Original upstream recipe and assertions remain byte-identical. Real execution of the actual owned shell block verifies enabled/disabled conditions, preserved hard limit and isolated build-child limits; full inherited target recipes remain separately required.
asan_tracing_environment_review: Select an owned FILE_ENV wrapper which exports INSTALL_BCC_TRACING_TOOLS=true before sourcing the unchanged upstream ASAN environment. Both host setup and Docker image build receive the intended BCC/header packages and capability flags. Remove workflow sed mutation which invalidated the original environment source checksum. Compiler/options, original source hashes and test selections unchanged. Actual hosted execution remains unverified. Non-fuzz container builds select a separate owned imagefile which copies original environment scripts and owned wrappers to their declared paths. The upstream imagefile/base-install command and dedicated fuzz image/driver remain unchanged. The runtime-inputs image stage permits testing actual Docker COPY and environment sourcing without reinstalling tools.
enabled_linux_tracing_review: Provision BCC Python bindings/tools for the eight reviewed Linux functional recipes that enable USDT. Source the same owned helper in host/container setup and image build; preserve all compiler, feature, dependency and test settings. Match running-host kernel headers in the workflow, mount headers/modules read-only, and allow the required original root/BPF tracing inside isolated containers. Build-only, non-Linux and dedicated fuzz jobs preserve their previous environment. Source-only environment and actual image-input checks are infrastructure evidence, never framework/hosted passes.
original_failure_reporting_review: Retain parsed original functional case results before rejecting a failed aggregate/exit, and explicitly record missing original case/transport evidence as unverified. Counts and CSV remain available on failure. Fail-fast original-before-native gating, assertions, selections and successful execution commands are unchanged. Infrastructure fixtures cover actual failed aggregates and abnormal exits; this is not new target-platform runtime evidence.
enabled_linux_python_prerequisites_revie: Provision Python ZeroMQ for the reviewed Debian/Ubuntu functional recipes and add pinned pycapnp only where IPC is enabled and the original environment omitted it. Preserve existing pip requirements; Ubuntu22.04 does not receive the unsupported --break-system-packages option. Export added PIP_PACKAGES through host/container setup. Original compiler, dependency build flags, features, test selections and assertions remain unchanged. Actual-recipe regression checks all eight environments, disabled/fuzz routing and idempotence; package/runtime execution remains separately required.

iwyu_source_restoration.scope: The unchanged upstream recipe rejects enforced include edits but permits its subsequent warning phase to apply suggestions. The owned controller retains per-consensus suggestions and original/analysis hashes, then restores exact input C/C++ bytes/modes before the next consensus phase. Nonzero recipe exits still stop before native; unrelated source drift and changes in other recipes remain fatal.
iwyu_source_restoration.runtime_scope: Infrastructure contract regression only; no full IWYU analysis or framework pass inferred.

inherited_feature_guard_review: Recognize unconditional feature guards inherited by a single test class through an unambiguous single-base chain in sibling source modules, without importing or executing those modules. Record the actual declaration source; child overrides, conditional guards, ambiguous classes/bases and cycles remain unverified. Missing enabled prerequisites and failed cases remain failures or unverified. Three existing native wallet-dependent scripts inherit their original skip guard; no test is newly disabled. Existing run commands, original-first ordering, selections, assertions and builds are unchanged.
